items.criterion: Access Flipkart as the specified platform
items.description: Navigate to Flipkart (starting URL may already be https://www.flipkart.com/) and attempt to use it to complete the task. Full credit if Flipkart is accessible and the agent proceeds with shopping, OR if Flipkart is blocked (e.g., CAPTCHA), down, or otherwise inaccessible and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent quickly switches away without first attempting Flipkart when it appears accessible.

items.criterion: Find an Adidas shoe with blue color selected/clearly indicated
items.description: Locate a product listing for an Adidas shoe where the chosen variant/color is blue (via color filter, variant selection, or clear product title/image indication). Full credit if the selected shoe is Adidas and blue. Partial credit if the shoe is Adidas but blue is not clearly confirmed/selected (ambiguous), or if blue is confirmed but brand is not Adidas due to navigation error. No credit if neither Adidas nor blue is satisfied when valid options exist.

items.criterion: Add the blue Adidas shoe to cart (no checkout)
items.description: Add the identified blue Adidas shoe to the Flipkart cart. Full credit if the cart shows the Adidas shoe (blue variant) added with a reasonable default quantity (e.g., 1) and the agent stops at/after the cart page without attempting purchase. Full credit also if add-to-cart is prevented by uncontrollable issues (out of stock for the blue variant, forced login/account wall before add-to-cart, site errors) and the agent clearly reports the specific blocker encountered. Partial credit if the agent adds an Adidas shoe but wrong color, or adds a blue shoe but wrong brand, when the correct option was available. No credit for claiming it was added without evidence or for not attempting add-to-cart.
